question:
Choose the correct meaning of idiom:

**To play the second fiddle**

options.text: To pretend submission in order to dominate
To support another while accepting inferior status

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. "To support another while accepting inferior status".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

 
• The idiom **"To play the second fiddle"** means to take a subordinate or less important role in relation to someone else. (दूसरे के अधीन रहना)

 

 
• **Example:** She was content to play the second fiddle to her husband, supporting him in his career while she managed the home.

 

 

 
• The correct meaning of the idiom is to **"support another while accepting inferior status."** (किसी अन्य का समर्थन करना और निम्न स्थिति को स्वीकार करना)

 

 
• **Example:** In the band, John was happy to play the second fiddle to his more talented brother, letting him shine in the spotlight.

 

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: To pretend submission in order to dominate** (प्रभुत्व पाने के लिए झूठा समर्पण दिखाना)

 

 
• **Example:** He pretended to agree with the manager’s decisions, but it was just a strategy to take control later.

 

 

 
• **Option 3: To refuse recognition despite achievement** (उपलब्धियों के बावजूद मान्यता से इनकार करना)

 

 
• **Example:** Despite his great contribution to the project, he refused recognition because he believed it was a team effort.

 

 

 
• **Option 4: To operate without being named** (बिना नाम के कार्य करना)

 

 
• **Example:** The anonymous donor preferred to operate without being named, helping the needy without any recognition.

 

 

37:T6e4,

The correct answer is **option 3.**
